gen.//: `gen` must not declare a path inside `build`'s output directory. It did (`dist/custom-elements.json`), which nx's own guidance forbids: two targets owning overlapping paths makes a restore of one able to disturb the other. `build` owns `dist`; `gen` owns `src/generated`. The second overlap of the same kind — the inferred `typecheck` target emitting into `dist` and declaring it — is what actually emptied `packages/core/dist`; see packages/core/project.json and the `typecheck` target below.

typecheck.//: Explicit, so the @nx/js/typescript plugin's inferred one (tsc --build --emitDeclarationOnly, outputs: dist) is not used: that one emits into the dist that build owns and declares it as an output, and a cache hit on it restored a declaration-only snapshot over the full dist. A typecheck writes nothing and claims nothing.
